thread:
oliver: Quick checkpoint  final GA safety-net items. Need owners for SLA wording, public pricing exposure (burst caps), support escalation, monitoring retention, and the pilot "early access" guardrails. Target GA in 9d. Please ack + blockers.
meera: Proposed SLA: Paid customers 99.9% monthly, Enterprise add-on 99.95%, Trial: best-effort (no credits). Include per-surface SLOs: generation vs embeddings. Will draft precise wording and sample credit calc.
sam: From infra: Auto-fallback strategy: prefer graded fallback -> reduce max_tokens -> quantized variant -> short-term 429 for new sessions. Rollback triggers: sustained error>2% for 8m OR p95>600ms 10m. I'll add the explicit backoff sequence.
anya: Docs/AE: I'll own the customer-facing "what to expect at GA" and an internal one-pager for AE. Also will add a short canned response matrix for CS. ETA Tue noon.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled 2024-06-01T03:00Z. Smoke: 130rps for 20m. Auto-rollback if error_rate >= 4% for 5m. Alerts to #launch-run and #launch-pager.
meera: Monitoring: keep metric scrape at 15s for 72h post-launch; traces 14d retention; logs 21d retention for launch project. Required alerts: token_error_rate > 0.35% sustained 5m, p95 latency > 180ms for 10m, cache_hit_drop > 18% absolute. Also: model-eval regression alert > 4% on canary eval set.
sam: Adding a new metric: fallback_trigger_count (labelled by variant) and model_variance_score. Will also surface per-customer RU burn rate to detect noisy tenants.
finops: Note: extended trace retention will have cost impact. Recommend restricting 21d logs/traces to launch project ID and enabling a budget alert at $1k/day.
meera: Pricing exposure: we want to publish RU bands + explicit burst cap language (eg: bursts above 5k RU/s may be throttled or billed at surcharge). Also a soft quota for new accounts during first 30 days (to avoid abuse). Need FinOps + Sales approval.
legal-bot: legal: flag  credit calc and force-majeure language. Please include sample amendment for Enterprise contracts re: Dedicated/private support. We'll review SLA PR once posted.
oliver: Risk list quick: (1) burst autoscale costs, (2) silent quality regressions, (3) docs lag - especially SDK examples and migration notes. Owners: Sam -> fallback + metrics + canary config; Anya -> docs + AE one-pager; Meera -> SLA text + monitoring alerts; FinOps -> pricing caps + budget alerts; Legal -> SLA review.
sam: Action: PRing canary + rollback config with example snippet. Example I'll include in PR:
```yaml
autoscale:
  max_scale: 120
  burst_guard:
    ru_threshold: 5000 # RU/s
    throttle_to: 1000
circuit_breaker:
  error_threshold: 0.02
  window_s: 480
  fallback_sequence: ["reduce_max_tokens","route_quantized_small","reject_new_sessions"]
```
PR: https://git.internal/infra/pull/8742 (runbooks linked).
anya: I'll stage docs in /docs/ga/ and include an "Early access" bullet that explains the soft quota behavior and downgrade path for Dedicated customers. Will also prepare AE training slides.
meera: SLA draft will include per-route SLO table and an appendix explaining how fallback impacts availability measurement. Also adding a short "how credits are computed" example. PRing by EOD.
finops: We'll aim to confirm RU bands by Thu. If pricing page is blocked, we can soft-launch with "contact sales for Enterprise" and keep Hobby/Team bands visible.
oliver: Support plan: reinforced 48h coverage first 72h (12h overlapping shifts), then hand back to normal oncall. Need the oncall rota posted and the launch-pager created.
sam: I'll create runbook IDs and attach them to each alert. Also setting temporary increased scrape frequency for critical metrics.
legal-bot: Reminder: include data residency language for Private deployments on the pricing page and SLA draft.
oliver: Collect confirmations by EOD Fri. If no objections, defaults locked: SLA per above, fallback sequence as above, support rota as above, monitoring retention scoped to launch project, pricing pages with RU bands + burst caps.
meera: Acked. Posting SLA PR in 30m.
anya: Acked. Staging docs now.
finops: Acked. Will sync with Sales for RU numbers.
sam: Acked. Opening infra PR.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder - increase metric retention to 21d for logs for launch project.
